items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 25 at 12:59AM PDT until October 29 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 5 AM this morning to 1 PM PDT Thursday during high
tides.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur in the
morning hours.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents in the warned area
should be alert for rising water and take appropriate action
to protect life and property. High tides each day will occur
in the morning. Tides may be anywhere from 1 to 1.7 feet above
predicted.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.
